enunciado: Traverse by levels the BST of 8, 3, 10, 1, 6, 14, 4, 7, 13 using a queue of nodes, printing each level on its own line.
objetivos: Combine a tree with a queue
Separate levels by counting how many nodes each has
pistas: Enqueue the root; while the queue is not empty, take a node out and enqueue its children.
When a level starts, the queue size is the number of nodes on that level.
The queue stores references to Node, not values.
